summary: Two skiers triggered a size-2 slab avalanche on Schuykill Ridge (Birthday Bowl); one was partially buried and both were injured. Crested Butte Search and Rescue evacuated both.
notes: Date approximate: CAIC marks 02/19 as estimated. CBAC 2017-18 annual report (Forecaster's Summary, opened run 173) confirms a size-2 slab on 2/19 with CB SAR evacuating the two injured skiers. CBN account (opened run 185): CBSAR pres. Randy Felix — 18 volunteers + 2 CBAC members, two hasty skinning teams, ~5-hr op in near-whiteout wind/blowing snow; one toboggan evac (severe non-life-threatening injuries), second with isolated limb injury + lost ski; both skiers self-arrested/extricated before teams arrived. [2026-09-12 run 240: SnowBrains first-person account merges: injured skiers named by the Crested Butte Avalanche Center as Ben Pritchett and Evan Ross; CBAC detail: skier 2 carried ~1000 vertical ft into trees, partial burial, crawled downhill severely injured; CB SAR contacted both below the debris and evacuated them to medical care.]
